```{r}
fabae<-read.csv("Phytohormones_Batch-1.csv")
fabae <- fabae  %>%
  filter(!is.na(weight))

fabae_without_3 <- fabae %>%
  filter(hpi != 3)

pisum<-read.csv("Phytohormones_Batch-2.csv")
pisum <- pisum  %>%
  filter(!is.na(weight))

pisum_without_3 <- pisum %>%
  filter(hpi != 3)


three_biotypes<-read.csv("Phytohormones_Batch-3.csv")
three_biotypes <- three_biotypes %>%
  filter(!is.na(SA))
three_biotypes_without_3 <- three_biotypes %>%
  filter(hpi != 3)



library(car)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
df<-pisum


# ================================
# PCA with explanatory factors
# ================================

# ---- Ensure factors ----
df[,1:3] <- lapply(df[,1:3], as.factor)

# ---- Remove rows with NA in numeric data ----
df <- df[complete.cases(df[,7:ncol(df)]), ]

# ---- Select numeric data for PCA (columns 6 to end) ----
pca_data <- df[,7:ncol(df)]

# ---- Run PCA ----
pca <- prcomp(pca_data,
              center = TRUE,
              scale. = TRUE)

# ---- Explained variance ----
explained_var <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)

# ---- Create PCA dataframe ----
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x)

# ---- Add explanatory factors ----
pca_df$Factor1 <- df[[1]]
pca_df$Factor2 <- df[[2]]
pca_df$Factor3 <- df[[3]]


# ---- Create combination of all three factors ----
pca_df$Combo <- interaction(pca_df$Factor1, pca_df$Factor2, pca_df$Factor3, sep = "_")

# ---- Plot PCA ----
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Combo)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Combo), linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(explained_var[1]*100,1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(explained_var[2]*100,1), "%)"),
    color = "Factor1 + Factor2 + Factor3"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```

```{r}
df<-three_biotypes


# ================================
# PCA with explanatory factors
# ================================

# ---- Ensure factors ----
df[,1:2] <- lapply(df[,1:2], as.factor)

# ---- Remove rows with NA in numeric data ----
df <- df[complete.cases(df[,5:ncol(df)]), ]

# ---- Select numeric data for PCA (columns 6 to end) ----
pca_data <- df[,6:ncol(df)]

# ---- Run PCA ----
pca <- prcomp(pca_data,
              center = TRUE,
              scale. = TRUE)

# ---- Explained variance ----
explained_var <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)

# ---- Create PCA dataframe ----
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x)

# ---- Add explanatory factors ----
pca_df$Factor1 <- df[[1]]
pca_df$Factor2 <- df[[2]]


# ---- Create combination of all three factors ----
pca_df$Combo <- interaction(pca_df$Factor1, pca_df$Factor2, sep = "_")

# ---- Plot PCA ----
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Combo)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Combo), linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(explained_var[1]*100,1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(explained_var[2]*100,1), "%)"),
    color = "Factor1 + Factor2 + Factor3"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```

## SA

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 1. Control treatment order
# -----------------------------
fabae$treatment <- factor(fabae$treatment, levels = c("control", "AF001"))

# -----------------------------
# 2. Compute control mean per genotype × hpi
# -----------------------------
control_means <- fabae %>%
  filter(treatment == "control") %>%
  group_by(genotype, hpi) %>%
  summarise(control_mean = mean(SA, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------
# 3. Compute AF001 - control mean
# -----------------------------
af_diff <- fabae %>%
  filter(treatment == "AF001") %>%
  left_join(control_means, by = c("genotype","hpi")) %>%
  mutate(
    SA = SA - control_mean,
    treatment = "AF001 - control"
  )

# -----------------------------
# 4. Combine datasets
# -----------------------------
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  fabae,
  af_diff
)

plot_df$treatment <- factor(
  plot_df$treatment,
  levels = c("control", "AF001", "AF001 - control")
)

# -----------------------------
# 5. Plot
# -----------------------------
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = hpi, y = SA, color = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    aes(group = treatment),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(genotype ~ treatment) +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r}

# -----------------------------
# 1. Compute control mean
# -----------------------------
control_means <- three_biotypes %>%
  filter(treatment == "control") %>%
  group_by(hpi) %>%
  summarise(control_mean = mean(SA, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------
# 2. Compute treatment - control
# -----------------------------
diff_df <- three_biotypes %>%
  filter(treatment != "control") %>%
  left_join(control_means, by = "hpi") %>%
  mutate(
    SA = SA - control_mean,
    treatment = paste0(treatment, " - control")
  )

# -----------------------------
# 3. Combine datasets
# -----------------------------
plot_df <- bind_rows(three_biotypes, diff_df)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Plot
# -----------------------------
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = hpi, y = SA, color = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    aes(group = treatment),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ treatment, ncol = 3) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 20)) +
  theme_bw()
```

## ABA

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Control treatment order
# -----------------------------
fabae$treatment <- factor(
  fabae$treatment,
  levels = c("control", "AF001")
)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Plot ABA evolution over hpi
# -----------------------------
ggplot(fabae, aes(x = hpi, y = ABA, color = treatment)) +
  
  # individual points
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 2) +
  
  # mean trend line
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    aes(group = treatment),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # mean points
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  # separate panels by genotype
  facet_wrap(~ genotype) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  
  labs(
    x = "Hours post inoculation (hpi)",
    y = "ABA",
    color = "Treatment",
    title = "Evolution of ABA over time"
  )

```

##filtering

```{r}


hormones <- c("ABA","JA.Ile","JA","SA","OPDA")
n_keep <- 3

# global standard deviation per hormone
global_sd <- sapply(three_biotypes[hormones], sd, na.rm = TRUE)

three_biotypes_clean <- three_biotypes %>%
  
  group_by(hpi, treatment) %>%
  
  mutate(
    across(all_of(hormones),
           ~ (. - mean(., na.rm = TRUE)) / (global_sd[cur_column()] + 1e-6),
           .names = "z_{col}")
  ) %>%
  
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    outlier_score = sqrt(sum(c_across(starts_with("z_"))^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(hpi, treatment) %>%
  
  arrange(outlier_score, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  filter(row_number() <= n_keep) %>%
  
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-starts_with("z_"), -outlier_score)
```

## SA

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 1. Control treatment order
# -----------------------------
fabae_clean$treatment <- factor(fabae_clean$treatment, levels = c("control", "AF001"))

# -----------------------------
# 2. Compute control mean per genotype × hpi
# -----------------------------
control_means <- fabae_clean %>%
  filter(treatment == "control") %>%
  group_by(genotype, hpi) %>%
  summarise(control_mean = mean(SA, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------
# 3. Compute AF001 - control mean
# -----------------------------
af_diff <- fabae_clean %>%
  filter(treatment == "AF001") %>%
  left_join(control_means, by = c("genotype","hpi")) %>%
  mutate(
    SA = SA - control_mean,
    treatment = "AF001 - control"
  )

# -----------------------------
# 4. Combine datasets
# -----------------------------
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  fabae_clean,
  af_diff
)

plot_df$treatment <- factor(
  plot_df$treatment,
  levels = c("control", "AF001", "AF001 - control")
)

# -----------------------------
# 5. Plot
# -----------------------------
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = hpi, y = SA, color = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    aes(group = treatment),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(genotype ~ treatment) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-5, 20))
  theme_bw()

```
